title: 地方菜正在出圈②贵州酸汤：不放一滴醋，酸掉一个省 | Rising Flavors P2 · Guizhou Sour Soup 🍲
description:
不放醋也能这么酸——你能吃酸吗？评论区报到，几分酸你受得了。

【这个夏天·地方菜正在出圈 第2集 贵州红酸汤】一锅鲜红的酸汤，酸掉一个省，可它不放一滴醋。贵州红酸汤的酸，全靠发酵：本地番茄（毛辣果）和辣椒装进坛子，密封自然发酵五六个月，取出磨成浆，再发酵大约半个月，才熬出这口酸香醇厚、微微带辣的红汤。苗族、侗族有句老话——"三天不吃酸，走路打蹿蹿"：早年山里缺盐，就用发酵的酸来"以酸代盐"下饭。舀一勺木姜子，那股山野的鲜直窜脑门。凯里酸汤鱼的制作技艺，是国家级非物质文化遗产。如今这一锅酸汤走出大山、做成大产业，成了红汤界的新顶流。

Ep.2 Guizhou. A red pot sours an entire province — with zero vinegar. Guizhou's red sour soup gets its tang purely from fermentation: local tomatoes and chili sealed in jars for 5-6 months, milled, then fermented again for about half a month. The Miao and Dong have a saying — "three days without sour and your legs go wobbly" — born when salt was scarce and fermented sourness seasoned the food instead. A spoon of litsea pepper sends the aroma straight to your head. Kaili's sour-soup-fish technique is national intangible cultural heritage, and today this once-mountain dish has become one of China's hottest hotpot flavors.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & industry note, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
